plugin.name: GTA Liberty City Stories PPSSPP Fusion Fix
MAIN.SkipIntro.description: Skip the opening intro. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
MAIN.ForceAspectRatio.description: Use the emulator aspect ratio automatically, or force a width:height ratio.
CONTROLS.HoldVehicleCamera.description: When you turn the camera with the right stick in a vehicle, it stays there, so you can look back while driving. It swings back behind the vehicle two seconds after you let go. Off keeps the original camera, which swings back behind the vehicle as you drive.
CONTROLS.ModernControlScheme.description: Use the alternate modern control scheme. For the best experience, swap buttons and triggers in the emulator settings, so LT/RT aim and shoot, brake and accelerate. Press Aim + Jump to reload the weapon. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting in the hub.
CONTROLS.PCCheats.description: Type these PC cheat words during gameplay: THUGSTOOLS, PROFESSIONALTOOLS, NUTTERTOOLS, ALWAYSCARRYCASH, PRECIOUSPROTECTION, ASPIRINE, YOUWONTTAKEMEALIVE, LEAVEMEALONE. Native cheat effects and save warnings still apply. Disabled while paused.
FOV.RestoreCutsceneFOV.description: Cutscenes ignore the field-of-view multiplier and keep their original framing. Aspect correction always applies. Restart after hub changes.
FOV.FOVFactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view on top of the widescreen correction. 1.0 is the original framing; higher is wider. Cutscenes are not changed.
FOV.CutsceneBorders.description: Black bars that keep cutscenes in their 16:9 cinematic frame: letterbox above and below on narrower screens, pillarbox at the sides on wider screens.
MAIN.TextLanguage.description: Language of the Plugins menu in the game (English only for now). Close and reopen Plugins after changing it.
fovfactor.description: Multiplies the gameplay field of view on top of the widescreen correction. 1.0 is the original framing; higher is wider. Cutscenes are not changed.
hudaspect.description: Keeps the HUD inside a centered box of this aspect ratio (for example 16:9 on an ultrawide screen). Auto uses the whole screen.
MAIN.GamepadIcons.description: Choose prompt and controller artwork matching your bindings in PPSSPP. PSP preserves the original artwork. The guest cannot detect the host controller type, so choose the set manually. Missing or incompatible icon files preserve the affected original artwork. Auto uses Xbox 360 artwork.
lights.description: Light headlights, tail, brake and reverse lights on car and bike body textures. Enabled by default. Restart the emulated game after changing this setting.
